_comment: Grade 9 Science diagrams, one per item of the figure list (68 of 68). Titles were cropped off the original screenshots so they do not give answers away, and the screenshots were enlarged 1.5x; letters A, B, C... were added to blank answer boxes that point at a part (boxes already lettered in the source, and boxes whose purpose is unclear, were left alone). Chapter names are the NCERT Class 9 titles. A 'note' says what was added or flags a reading I was unsure of (look for 'best guess'); labels are kept under 80 characters for the upload limit.

figures.subject: Science
figures.topic: Particle arrangement in solid, liquid and gas
figures.caption: Three boxes of blue particles: tightly packed in a regular grid, close together but irregular, and far apart and moving, each with a lettered blank box below
figures.note: Letters A-C were added.

figures.subject: Science
figures.topic: Heating curve of ice to steam
figures.caption: A graph of temperature (-20 to 120 degrees C) against time: the red line rises, stays flat at 0 degrees C, rises, stays flat at 100 degrees C, then rises; shaded zones read Ice (solid), Water (liquid), Steam (gas); two lettered blank boxes point to the flat parts
labels: A: Boiling point, 100 °C (latent heat of vaporisation)
B: Melting point, 0 °C (latent heat of fusion)
figures.note: Letters A and B were added. A points to the 100 degree C flat part and B to the 0 degree C flat part.
